evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Draft ADR 0004 rejecting a hosted 'context dump' export API for agents (prefer skill + one-shard reads). WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=evals/files/design-fixture/docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-design-architecture, record the decision as a durable ADR under docs/features/adr/, update the ADR index, and keep the feature catalog describing current behavior only. Do not implement CLI or package code.
evals.expected_output: Creates or updates an ADR under docs/features/adr/ (Context / Decision / Consequences), links it from the ADR index, does not add product/package implementation, and does not dump large code samples into the ADR.

assertions.name: creates_adr_markdown
assertions.description: Edited or created a Markdown ADR under docs/features/adr/ (not only chat text)

assertions.name: updates_adr_index
assertions.description: Updated docs/features/adr/index.md to list the new ADR

assertions.name: adr_has_context_decision_consequences
assertions.description: ADR includes Context, Decision, and Consequences (or equivalent sections)

assertions.name: no_product_code_edits
assertions.description: No new or modified product source under packages/ or src/

assertions.name: no_large_impl_dumps
assertions.description: ADR body has no large fenced implementation snippets (no multi-function TypeScript/JavaScript dumps); at most short CLI command examples if needed

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Update the architecture notes for a proposed 'compile cache' boundary: document components, data flow, and acceptance-level contracts. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=evals/files/design-fixture/docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-design-architecture, revise the existing architecture shard under docs/features/ (and protocol notes if needed) so intent and boundaries are clear. Retire any superseded design bullets in that shard. Do not write tests or implementation.
evals.expected_output: Updates docs/features/ architecture / protocol shards with system intent (diagrams, contracts, data model at design level), removes superseded design text from durable shards, and leaves package code untouched.

assertions.name: updates_architecture_shard
assertions.description: Modified a shard under docs/features/ describing architecture (components, flow, or contracts)

assertions.name: intent_level_design
assertions.description: Design is intent-level (what/why/boundaries), not a step-by-step implementation guide with large code

assertions.name: removes_superseded_design
assertions.description: Superseded 'old approach' planning bullets in the fixture shard are removed or replaced with as-intended design

assertions.name: mentions_system_value
assertions.description: Mentions or implies end-user / system value of the architectural boundary

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM=Design a 'shard dependency graph' feature end-to-end: ADRs, feature docs, client guide, CLI flags, TypeScript modules, and unit tests. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP=evals/files/design-fixture/docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md. Using /mdcp-design-architecture only, stay inside design scope for this session.
evals.expected_output: Agent scopes to design/ADR/feature-architecture shards only; refuses or defers client-guide polish, CLI implementation, and tests to other helpers (e.g. mdcp-feature-level / mdcp-ux); does not land a full feature implementation.

assertions.name: design_artifacts_only
assertions.description: Produces design artifacts under docs/features/ and/or docs/features/adr/ only (or asks to narrow scope before editing)

assertions.name: no_cli_typescript_impl
assertions.description: Does not implement TypeScript/CLI under packages/

assertions.name: no_tests_as_delivery
assertions.description: Does not add unit/integration tests as delivery for this WORK_ITEM

assertions.name: defers_client_guide
assertions.description: Does not treat docs/client/ end-user guide authorship as in-scope primary work for this helper

assertions.name: states_design_only_scope
assertions.description: Explicitly states design-only scope / next steps for implementation helpers when the ask is oversized
